title: Recommended ingestion sequence
notes: Scouting-first for integration with industry knowledge bases; event layer provides contextual enrichment rather than sole discovery.

values.sources_input: CAMEO full lookup; GKG themes; GCAM; actor & geo lookups
values.acceptance_criterion: Validate keys/types, source versions; no fabricated tags
Seed queries by technology/application + entity aliases; retain full provenance

values.sources_input: Events + Mentions + GKG; BigQuery or manifests
values.acceptance_criterion: Join by GlobalEventID and collection/identifier; test coverage/gaps

values.sources_input: Claim extraction, entity resolution, technology/application tagging
values.acceptance_criterion: Local KB joins; dedup syndicated stories; evidence-backed claims

values.sources_input: BigQuery partitioned queries or master manifests
values.acceptance_criterion: Start bounded window; normalize media volume; replay late files

values.sources_input: Industry KB primary sources, official announcements, papers, contracts
values.acceptance_criterion: Separate verified fact from media report; validate novelty and maturity
